newsitem.title: JAPAN: OECD official says 115 yen/dollar good for Japan.
newsitem.headline: OECD official says 115 yen/dollar good for Japan.

text.p: An exchange rate of about 115 yen to the dollar would be good for both Japan's economy and those of its trading partners, Kumiharu Shigehara, deputy secretary-general of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), said on Monday.
"As my personal view, if the dollar should stabilise at around 115 yen, that would be welcome news for Japan's economy and for its trading partners," he told a news conference in Tokyo.
Shigehara also said concerns that the yen's weakness would inhibit Japan's structural reform efforts had receded recently due to the yen's appreciation.
